capabilities: Chat with the vault to search, summarize, and reason over notes
Create research plans, search the web, and fetch and save pages
Write and edit notes from conversational instructions
Run bulk operations like frontmatter updates and file moves with link fixing
Extend the agent with custom skills, an extension system, and MCP support
extras: In-depth documentation lives in repo files (docs/, src/ subdirectories) rather than the README; the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Local-only use requires Ollama, which the README says does not support chat tools.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in conversational agent that can act on the vault by searching, editing, moving files, or running multi-step research tasks.

relations.evidence: PI Agent design influence (minimal core, extensibility)

summary: Agentic AI chat plugin that reads, writes, searches, and summarizes vault notes, with web research, bulk file operations, and an extensible skill system.
